name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
overview: A demand-driven wage employment programme guaranteeing 100 days of unskilled manual work in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer for it.
objectives: Guarantee wage employment to rural households
Create durable rural infrastructure and assets
Enhance livelihood security in rural areas

benefits.title: Guaranteed Wage Employment
benefits.description: Up to 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per household per financial year

benefits.title: Unemployment Allowance
benefits.description: Allowance payable if work is not provided within 15 days of demand

otherCriteria: Adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work

applicationProcess.description: Register with Gram Panchayat for a Job Card
Wages credited directly to bank/post office account

faqs.question: How many days of employment are guaranteed?
faqs.answer: Up to 100 days per household per financial year.

faqs.question: What happens if work isn't provided in time?
faqs.answer: An unemployment allowance becomes payable as per state rules.

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihood Mission (DAY-NRLM)
overview: A mission to organise rural poor households into Self Help Groups and build their capacities for sustainable livelihoods through financial inclusion and skill development.
objectives: Organise rural poor into strong self-managed institutions
Enhance access to financial services for rural poor
Diversify livelihood opportunities for SHG members

benefits.title: Community Institution Building
benefits.description: Formation and strengthening of Self Help Groups and their federations

benefits.title: Access to Credit
benefits.description: Bank linkage and revolving fund support for SHGs

benefits.title: Skill and Livelihood Training
benefits.description: Capacity building for diverse livelihood activities

otherCriteria: Rural poor households, with priority to women, willing to join Self Help Groups

applicationProcess.description: Join or form a Self Help Group in the village
Group undergoes training and capacity building
SHG linked to bank for credit and revolving fund

faqs.question: Who can join DAY-NRLM SHGs?
faqs.answer: Rural poor households, with strong focus on women members.

faqs.question: What support is provided to SHGs?
faqs.answer: Capacity building, revolving fund and bank credit linkage.

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM)

ministry.name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
ministry.department: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission

overview: A mission to reduce urban poverty by enabling urban poor households to access self-employment and skilled wage employment opportunities, resulting in an appreciable improvement in their livelihoods.
objectives: Enable sustainable livelihood opportunities for urban poor
Promote self-employment and skilled wage employment
Provide shelter and social security to vulnerable urban populations

benefits.title: Skill Training
benefits.description: Employable skill training with placement linkage for urban poor youth

benefits.title: Self-Employment Support
benefits.description: Subsidised loans for setting up individual or group micro-enterprises

otherCriteria: Urban poor individuals, particularly those living below the urban poverty line

applicationProcess.description: Register at the Urban Local Body/City Livelihood Centre
Undergo skill training or apply for enterprise loan
Receive placement assistance or loan disbursement

faqs.question: What support is available under DAY-NULM?
faqs.answer: Skill training, self-employment loans, SHG formation and shelter for urban homeless.

faqs.question: Who is the target group?
faqs.answer: Urban poor households and individuals below the urban poverty line.

name: National Career Service (NCS)
overview: An online platform connecting job seekers with employers, career counselling services, vocational guidance, and information on skill development courses across the country.
objectives: Provide a common platform connecting job seekers and employers
Offer career counselling and vocational guidance
Facilitate job fairs and skill development linkages

benefits.title: Job Search Portal
benefits.description: Free access to job listings from private and government employers

benefits.title: Career Counselling
benefits.description: Online and in-person career guidance and counselling services

otherCriteria: Job seekers, employers, and career counsellors across India

customQuestions.question: Are you 14 years of age or older?
Are you an individual seeking employment, career guidance, counselling, training or related career services?
Do you have a minimum educational qualification required for NCS registration?
Do you have a valid mobile number for registration/authentication?
Do you have at least one accepted identity document such as Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID, Driving Licence, Passport or UAN?

applicationProcess.description: Register as a job seeker on the NCS portal
Create profile with skills and qualifications
Search and apply for suitable job openings
Access career counselling and job fair information

faqs.question: Is registration on NCS free?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration and use of the portal is free for job seekers.

faqs.question: Who can use NCS?
faqs.answer: Job seekers, employers, skill providers, and career counsellors.

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana

ministry.name: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
ministry.department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

overview: A scheme to provide end-to-end support to traditional artisans and craftspeople practising 18 identified trades, including skill training, toolkit incentives, collateral-free credit and market support.
objectives: Preserve and promote traditional artisan trades
Improve quality and reach of products made by traditional craftspeople
Provide financial and market support to artisans

benefits.title: Skill Training
benefits.description: Basic and advanced skill training with stipend for traditional artisans

benefits.title: Toolkit Incentive
benefits.description: Toolkit incentive to purchase modern tools

benefits.title: Collateral-free Credit
benefits.description: Access to credit at concessional interest rates without collateral

otherCriteria: Practising one of the 18 identified traditional trades through family-based occupation

customQuestions.question: Are you 18 years of age or older?
Do you work as a traditional artisan or craftsperson using your hands and tools?
Does your occupation belong to one of the 18 trades covered under PM Vishwakarma?  Select Trade  Yes  4  Are you currently engaged in the selected traditional trade as your occupation?
Are you self-employed in the relevant trade and working in the unorganised sector?

Is your occupation one of the following: Carpenter, Boat Maker, Armourer, Mason, Blacksmith, Hammer & Tool Kit Maker, Locksmith, Goldsmith, Potter, Sculptor/Stone Carver/Stone Breaker, Cobbler/Shoesmith/Footwear Artisan, Basket/Mat/Broom Maker/Coir Weaver, Doll & Toy Maker, Barber, Garland Maker, Washerman, Tailor or Fish Net Maker?  Select Trade  One of these trades required  7  Has another member of your household already received PM Vishwakarma benefits?
Have you already received benefits under a similar credit-based self-employment/business development scheme of the Government?

applicationProcess.description: Register through Common Service Centre or PM Vishwakarma portal
Verification by gram panchayat/ULB and screening committee
Avail toolkit incentive and collateral-free loan

faqs.question: How many trades are covered?
faqs.answer: 18 traditional trades including carpenters, blacksmiths, potters, tailors and others.

faqs.question: Is the loan collateral-free?
faqs.answer: Yes, up to the prescribed limit under the scheme.
